requirements.desc: REQ-1: FAIL entry must record headSha and worktreeHash
requirements.note: `appendIssueLogFromGateResult` now attaches `headSha`/`worktreeHash` from `ctx.gitState` for retry-tracked phases, and `ctx.gitState` is captured before gate evaluation.

requirements.desc: REQ-2: gate-impl compares current state to latest same-phase FAIL before AI eval
requirements.note: Comparison is executed before AI call (`assertNoProgressSinceLastFail`), but lookup targets the latest same-phase FAIL that has state fields, not strictly the latest same-phase FAIL entry.

requirements.desc: REQ-3: throw NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL when state matches previous FAIL
requirements.note: On exact state match, code throws `Error` with `err.code = 'NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL'`; message includes previous FAIL reason and instruction to modify spec/implementation before retry.

requirements.desc: REQ-4: NO_PROGRESS_SINCE_LAST_FAIL does not increment gateRetry
requirements.note: Guard throws before AI invocation/normal command completion, so post-hook retry increment path is not reached.

requirements.desc: REQ-5: gate-impl prompt MUST require recording fix evidence before re-run
requirements.note: `src/flow/prompts/impl/gate-impl.md` now includes an explicit MUST to record what was fixed (or rationale) in issue-log before re-run.

requirements.desc: REQ-6: gate-impl prompt MUST forbid re-run with unchanged tree
requirements.note: Prompt now includes an explicit MUST forbidding re-run when working tree is unchanged since previous FAIL.

requirements.desc: REQ-7: missing state identifier on prior FAIL means no rejection
requirements.note: Entries lacking identifiers are skipped, but logic can still fall back to an older FAIL with identifiers instead of treating the latest FAIL-with-missing-fields as non-rejecting.

requirements.desc: REQ-8: PASS between FAILs resets the guard
requirements.note: Reset is implemented via `countGateRetry(...)=0` (metrics reset) rather than directly constraining selection to FAIL-after-latest-PASS in issue-log; behavior is aligned in common path but not strictly by entry-boundary rule.

summary.notes: Most core behavior is implemented (REQ-1,3,4,5,6), but strict interpretation of 'latest FAIL' semantics is not fully preserved because lookup skips missing-state FAIL entries and can use older FAILs; this affects full compliance for REQ-2, REQ-7, and REQ-8.
